title: Cross-lane observe denies without exposure or grant
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Assets publishes `asset_urls` under deny-all exposure. Billing calls `lane_observe` for that key and receives a typed deny — no silent bleed across JobLanes.
implementation: `JobLaneBroker.observe` returns `status: denied` when publisher exposure and standing grants/handoffs do not allow the caller (JL-05..06).
